title: Senior Simulation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Simulation Engineer to design and develop dynamic simulation models for our flexible pipe production facility using AnyLogic. The role will focus on modeling complex manufacturing lines, continuous pipe production, material flow, machine utilization, storage reel capacities, downtime events, and throughput projections. The engineer will support production optimization, bottleneck analysis, and capacity planning through accurate simulation models and data-driven insights.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop discrete-event, continuous/rate-based, and agent-based simulation models using AnyLogic.
* Model flexible pipe manufacturing processes, including production lines, machines, rollers/reels, buffers, operators, and material flow.
* Simulate continuous pipe production, line speeds, material consumption, reel transfers, and storage limitations.
* Model production interruptions such as bobbin depletion, welding stops, reel changes, changeovers, restart delays, and machine downtime.
* Analyze bottlenecks, machine utilization, WIP, storage capacity, throughput, and production constraints.
* Create input parameters, scenarios, dashboards, charts, and output reports within AnyLogic.
* Integrate with ML for iterating model behavior.
* Collaborate with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to validate assumptions and improve model accuracy.
* Maintain and update simulation models based on changes in machinery, layout, process flow, or product specifications.
* Regular collaboration with Denmark and international teams.
* International travel required, including visits to Brazil or Denmark.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–8 years of experience in simulation modeling, preferably for manufacturing or industrial systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with AnyLogic simulation software.
* Good understanding of DES, continuous/rate-based simulation, and hybrid modeling.
* Experience with AnyLogic Process Modeling Library, agents, events, statecharts, parameters, functions, and custom logic.
* Ability to translate real production processes and operational data into simulation parameters.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to present simulation results and improvement recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

The Business Analyst II acts as the connection point between business stakeholders and technical teams, independently driving requirements from elicitation through delivery. The overall objective is to ensure that delivered solutions remain aligned with business goals.

**Responsibilities**

* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process observation.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Map current-state and future-state business processes using standard modeling techniques such as BPMN, swimlane diagrams, and data flow diagrams.
* Facilitate requirements review sessions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need to delivered solution.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, developers, architects, and QA to ensure requirements are understood and delivered as intended.
* Support User Acceptance Testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating testing cycles, and managing defect triage.
* Analyze data and system configurations to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Evaluate the impact of proposed changes across dependent systems and business processes.
* Provide input into integration requirements when solutions involve third-party platforms, APIs, or cross-system data flows.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives, within an iterative delivery model.
* Produce and maintain documentation including business requirements documents (BRDs), process maps, decision logs, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Support change management and stakeholder communication around new feature rollouts.
* Deliver clear, complete, and well-organized documentation within established timelines.
* Adhere to established standards for requirements management and business analysis best practices.
* Proactively communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and open decisions.
* Work efficiently within a defined project scope and contract duration.
* Support testing, deployment, and stabilization efforts by ensuring business readiness and stakeholder alignment.

Time Zone: U.S. Central Time (CT). Some overlap with India Standard Time (IST) is expected.

Must-Have Skills:

* 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in technology-driven environments. Strong proficiency in requirements elicitation and documentation, including user stories, BRDs, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong proficiency in business process modeling and analysis. Strong proficiency in stakeholder management across both business and technical teams.
* Strong proficiency in UAT planning, coordination, and defect management.
* Demonstrated experience on projects involving CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) or comparable enterprise systems.
* Familiarity with system integrations, data flows, and API-based connectivity between platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross functional team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working in enterprise-scale Salesforce environments (Service Cloud, Omni-Channel, case management workflows).
* Understanding of the Salesforce object model, automation capabilities (Flows, Process Builder), and configuration versus customization trade-offs.
* Familiarity with data migration, reporting/analytics, or integration patterns such as REST APIs and middleware.
* Experience with complex data models, large-scale implementations, or multi system landscapes.
* Background in contact center operations, customer service, or support technology platforms.
* Experience gathering and documenting requirements for AI-driven features or services, such as predictive routing, intelligent case classification, or generative AI powered agent assist.
* Familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Einstein features or AI-powered automation within Service Cloud.
* Ability to define business rules, success metrics, and acceptance criteria for AI enabled workflows.
* Understanding of data readiness, quality, and governance considerations when scoping AI/ML initiatives.
* Exposure to prompt engineering concepts or evaluating generative AI tools for business process improvement.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder alignment on AI use cases, balancing business value against feasibility and risk.
* Experience working within Service Cloud or a customer service/support operations domain.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or Confluence.

title: Sr. Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline**
Clients & Industries
  
  
**Role Type**
C&I Business Operations Coordinator
  
  
**Business unit specific description – Clients & Industries – GDS Europe West**
Join our GDS Clients & Industries and you will help support the important business enablement functions that keep our organization running strong. As an Operations professional, you will work across teams both onshore and offshore to provide the knowledge, resources and tools that help EY deliver exceptional quality service to our clients, win in the marketplace and support EY’s growth and profitability.
  
  
With so many offerings, you can develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring and formal learning. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
  
  
The practice also works closely with the Region/Service Line/BD team with the project management / coordination activities. The role requires a comparable work experience, strong skills, work ethic and attention to detail for as the team has a high focus on accuracy and timeliness.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities:**

* Maintain pipeline hygiene and ensure the accuracy of sales and revenue data.
* Support account management activities and stakeholder engagement.
* Prepare business reports, forecasts, and performance updates.
* Collaborate with teams to resolve data issues and improve reporting quality.
* Provide insights to support business reviews, leadership meetings, and client discussions.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and digital tools.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
* Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
* Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
* Business acumen and Adaptability – Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
* Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
* Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc
* Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
* MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
* Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc
* High degree of professionalism and integrity

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years’ work experience in professional services industry.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
* Experience doing secondary research using Google and other external sources like Factiva, Company Inforgator, BoardEx, OneSource etc
* Content management – Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, preparation of newsletters, managing surveys etc
* Private Equity/Investment Banking Industry experience preferable but not essential.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Analyst: ThinkPalm Technologies in Kochi
description:
Business Analyst: ThinkPalm Technologies in Kochi B1, First Floor, Athulya Building, Infopark SEZ, Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala 682042 Start Date 30/06/2026 Full-Time

ThinkPalm Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is hiring a Business Analyst at its Athulya Building office at Infopark SEZ, Kakkanad, Kochi. The permanent role calls for 4 to 6 years of experience, deep marine domain exposure, and the ability to translate international client requirements into shippable user stories. Immediate joiners get priority.

Apply on Infopark

The opening adds another seat to the steady run of business analyst roles posted on the Kerala Trade Network jobs board. ThinkPalm has been operating from Infopark since 2010 and recently moved into the third floor of Athulya, a 368,000 sq. ft. campus on the Phase 1 side of the park, alongside much of Kochi's enterprise services crowd.

**What the Role Covers**

The analyst sits between marine clients abroad and the development team in Kochi. The day-to-day mix is split between requirement workshops, story writing, and quality checks. Marine domain knowledge runs through every conversation, since the client base is shipping operators and chemical tanker companies whose workflows do not translate well from a generic SaaS playbook.

* Run requirement-gathering sessions with international marine clients and document outcomes
* Translate business needs into SRS documents, features, and user stories
* Maintain the product backlog and act as liaison between stakeholders and engineering
* Participate in sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Coordinate UAT planning, test scenarios, and change-request triage

**Who Fits**

The hard requirement is marine domain experience, with at least three of the four to six total years spent on shipping, fleet operations, or comparable maritime workflows. Practical fluency with JIRA and Azure Boards is expected on day one. Cross-cultural communication is a recurring need given the time-zone spread of the customer base.

Preferred candidates bring chemical tanker operations knowledge, exposure to AI-driven product work, and wireframing tool experience for early prototyping. Candidates exploring adjacent product manager openings on Kerala Trade Network often find the seat works as a stepping stone in that direction.

**Working at ThinkPalm**

ThinkPalm runs enterprise, mobility, and communications engineering practices, with marine and telecom as anchor verticals. The Athulya office houses about 46,000 sq. ft. per floor, so the BA, engineering, and QA teams share a common floor rather than coordinating across buildings. The company maintains a steady customer presence in Europe and the Middle East according to its own company background page.

For anyone weighing the commute, the Athulya block sits inside Infopark SEZ Phase 1, the eastern Kochi corridor that also hosts most of the city's product-engineering employers. Other Kochi-area jobs sit a short walk away across Phase 1 and Phase 2.

**How to Apply**

Email a CV to soumya.n@thinkpalm.com and reference the Business Analyst role in the subject line. The company's general HR line is 0484-4104100 for follow-ups. The Infopark application deadline is 30 July 2026.

For other openings across Infopark and Technopark, browse the wider Kerala Trade Network jobs board.

title: ST - Telco-Aria Billing Cloud -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – Senior – Telecom Billing Analyst**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer’s business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.
* Investigate production billing issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution across product, integration, data and operations teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
* Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across global banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.

* Knowledge of derivative pricing concepts across asset classes (rates, equities, credit, FX, commodities)
* Solid grounding in mathematical foundations including stochastic calculus, differential and integral calculus, probability, linear algebra
* Understanding of optimization techniques (e.g., gradient‑based methods) relevant to calibration, risk analytics, and numerical model implementation.
* Experience in model development, validation, monitoring, and audit procedures (stress testing, back testing, benchmarking) of trading book models.
* Strong coding skills in advanced Python / C++ and basic SQL
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Exposure to market risk and counterparty credit risk methodologies (VaR, ES, SVaR, CVA, PFE) and time series techniques (e.g. GARCH).
* Hands on experience with pricing model development/validation (e.g., HW1F/2F, HJM, LMM, SABR, Heston, Dupire), volatility calibration, curve bootstrapping.
* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.

* Undergraduate or graduate degree in quantitative disciplines (Comp. Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, Physics) or PhD in quantitative topics

title: Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst**
**The opportunity**
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
  
  
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
  
  
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
* Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
* Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
* Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:

+ Workflow execution metrics
+ OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
+ Drift detection signals
+ ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation

* Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:

+ Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
+ Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
+ Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
+ Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management
+ Storage and compute provisioning concepts

* Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
* Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
* Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
* Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
* Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:

+ Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
+ PowerShell
+ Bash

* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years.
* Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years.
* ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years.
* SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years.
* KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
* Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
* Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
* Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
* Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
* Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
* OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
* Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
* Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
* Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
* Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years.
* PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
* Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
* Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
* Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
* Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
* Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
* Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.
* Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis.
* Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment.

**What We Look For**
A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale.

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

title: Data Analyst: Nesa Software in Kochi
description:
Data Analyst: Nesa Software in Kochi
**Nesa Software Pvt Ltd**
Infopark Phase I, Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala 682030 Start Date 10/07/2026 INR35,000.00 Full-Time More Details

Nesa Software Pvt Ltd is hiring a full-time Data Analyst at Infopark Kochi, with 3 or more years of experience required. The role sits inside the company's data engineering function, building ETL and ELT pipelines, developing Power BI dashboards, and turning raw operational data into business insights. Monthly pay falls between INR 30,000 and INR 40,000, plus provident fund and health insurance. The listing appears alongside other openings on Kerala Trade Network and inside the wider Kochi business network the site indexes.

Apply on Official Website

**About the Role**

Nesa Software's Data Analyst works across the company's data stack, moving records between source systems, cleaning them, modeling them for reporting, and publishing dashboards that operations, sales, and finance teams rely on daily. The position expects hands-on ownership of pipelines end to end, not report authoring on someone else's data warehouse.

Day-to-day responsibilities include:

* Designing and maintaining ETL and ELT pipelines that move data across multiple source and destination systems
* Managing several database instances at once, keeping schemas consistent and loads reliable
* Cleaning and transforming raw data so downstream reports and dashboards stay trustworthy
* Building Power BI dashboards for stakeholders, using DAX and Power Query for the data model
* Automating repetitive workflows with Power Automate and light scripting
* Providing analysis that helps business teams make specific decisions rather than abstract observations

**What You'll Need**

The employer expects 3+ years of work as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, with proof of ownership on real pipelines. Required capabilities:

* Advanced SQL, including query tuning and complex joins across normalized schemas
* ETL and ELT pipeline development, with a working understanding of orchestration and error handling
* Power BI and Power Query for report modeling, plus DAX for measures
* Advanced Excel including pivot tables, lookups, and dashboarding
* Data validation, quality checks, and basic data governance practices
* Automation with Power Automate and scripting for glue work between systems

**Salary and Benefits**

Monthly pay ranges from INR 30,000 to INR 40,000 based on experience and interview outcome. Benefits include provident fund contributions and health insurance. The position is full-time and permanent, not contract or gig.

**Why Kochi's Infopark**

Infopark Kakkanad is Kochi's flagship IT park, hosting more than 500 companies across software, product engineering, and IT services. For a data analyst, the value of being based here is density of peer companies within walking distance, so meetups, informal reference conversations, and short interview commutes are all easier than in a scattered market. Candidates can see other open jobs in Kochi to compare pay bands and role types.

For candidates comparing Kerala IT hubs, Kochi's Infopark and Trivandrum's Technopark now hire at similar seniority bands, though Kochi carries a stronger enterprise and product mix while Trivandrum tilts more toward services and R&D captives, per Infopark's live openings board.

**How to Apply**

Send a resume and a short note about your pipeline experience to recruitment@nesasoftware.com, or call +91 75938 33665 during business hours. The Infopark listing closes on 19 July 2026, so a shortlisted candidate has roughly a week for interviews before the position drops off the board. Full role details and employer contact information live on the official Infopark listing page.

Analyst and engineer roles across Kerala worth tracking are grouped in the Jobs and Careers section of the KTN blog, with hiring signals from Kochi, Trivandrum, and Kozhikode employers gathered in one place.

title: Lead Business Analyst Engineer
description:
**Senior Business Analyst - Payments**
**Location:**
| Open to any location | Occasional UAE travel
  
  
**About The Role**
We build compliance payment products used by banks and financial institutions across the UAE and GCC to process domestic, cross-border, instant, and WPS payments.
  
  
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will own the functional analysis from requirement through release. You'll work closely with bank stakeholders, sales, Key account Managers, architects, engineers, QA, and delivery teams.
  
  
You will be expected to understand the business problem behind each requirement, challenge unclear or impractical requests, define how the solution should behave, and stay involved through testing and release.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Functional analysis of payment capabilities. This covers business rules, validations, exceptions, failures, returns, reconciliation, and downstream impact.
* Requirement workshops with bank business, operations, and technology stakeholders. You'll convert ambiguous business needs into clear, complete, and testable requirements.
* Functional specifications that engineering teams can build from. These include user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, API requirements, data mapping, and business rules.
* Feasibility, gap, scope, dependency, and impact analysis for new requirements and change requests.
* Requirement traceability from business need through development, testing, UAT, and release.
* Testing support. You'll support SIT and UAT, clarify expected behaviour during defect triage, and validate delivered functionality against agreed requirements.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years as a Business Analyst, including at least 3 years on payments products or payment projects in banking or financial services preferably in UAE or any other GCCs.
* Experience analysing at least one end-to-end payment flow, including transaction processing, failures, returns, and reconciliation.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, including authentication, request and response structures, validations, error handling, and data mapping.
* Working knowledge of ISO 20022 message concepts and structures, such as pacs, pain, and camt.
* Experience conducting requirement workshops directly with bank or business stakeholders.
* Ability to write basic SQL queries for data validation and defect investigation.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with UAE payment schemes, such as UAEFTS, WPS, and Aani.
* Experience with payment hubs, orchestration, instant payments, open banking, clearing and settlement, or transaction monitoring.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
* Experience across Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.

**How You'll Work With AI**
We encourage analysts to use AI where it improves speed, analysis, and quality, and we'll support you in learning the tools. All use must follow company and client data-security policies.
  
  
**Typical Use Cases Include**

* Diagrams as code: creating process flows, sequence diagrams, and system workflows using tools such as Mermaid, so diagrams stay close to requirements and are easy to update.
* Early validation: building wireframes, clickable prototypes, or proofs of concept to test requirements with stakeholders before development starts.
* Automation: using small scripts to generate test data, validate payment messages, or run reconciliation checks.
* Requirement quality: using AI to surface ambiguity, missing scenarios, and edge cases. The analyst remains responsible for validating the result.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 3 months: you can explain the end-to-end flow of your payment capability, including its integrations, key rules, exceptions, dependencies, and limitations.
* Within 6 months: you are the primary functional point of contact for that capability across engineering, QA, delivery, and business stakeholders.

title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
description:
**Senior AI Evaluation Analyst**

**Location:**
Kochi

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Role Overview**

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation.

Co-Investments

* Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams where investment-backed campaigns, client-facing narratives, marketplace assets or enablement content are required to drive adoption, utilization and value realization of approved investments.

* Technology aptitude and comfort working at a business level across Microsoft solution areas such as Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, Cloud, Security, Business Applications and automation.
* Practical understanding of AI-enabled transformation, with the ability to support assessment of AI investment opportunities based on business value, adoption readiness, scalability and responsible AI considerations.

* Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI, dashboarding, workflow tools and AI-enabled productivity tools would be an added advantage.

* Strong problem-solving capability, analytical thinking, root-cause evaluation and mitigation planning, with the ability to work across multiple teams toward practical resolution.
* Good project management skills, including prioritization, tracking, governance, execution discipline, status reporting and management of multiple workstreams with competing timelines.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to create concise leadership updates, business narratives and decision-oriented materials.
* Experience working with alliance or partner programs in a professional services, consulting or technology-led organization; knowledge of EY and GDS operating models will be an advantage.

title: Engineering Systems Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and related engineering applications, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and efficient operation across integrated business platforms. Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The analyst will work closely with design engineers, product development teams, IT professionals, and third\-party vendors to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support engineering processes. Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application, system, and data\-related issues while ensuring minimal disruption to engineering operations.
* Write, maintain, and execute SQL queries to support reporting, data validation, data reconciliation, and engineering business processes.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PLM and integrated enterprise systems.
* Support engineering teams in the effective use of engineering systems, business applications, and product data management processes.
* Assist in analysing engineering and product data to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and third\-party vendors to gather requirements, support projects, and resolve technical issues.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, testing activities, and implementation of process improvements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, validation tools, and business intelligence outputs that support engineering operations.
* Assist with administration and routine maintenance activities for Windows Server environments supporting engineering applications.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, user guides, process documentation, test reports, release notes, and technical specifications.
* Support user training activities and assist in developing subject matter expertise within engineering and business teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and support activities, proactively driving issues through resolution while communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.
* The successful candidate will work under guidance of Senior Analyst, who will oversee their workload and scheduling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in information systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related subject is preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience supporting business applications, enterprise systems, engineering systems, or technical software platforms, with hands\-on experience using SQL for reporting, data analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting data\-related issues.
* Understanding of relational database concepts, data structures, and relationships between enterprise systems.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as PLM, ERP, Product Data Management (PDM), Document Management, CAD, or similar engineering systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, JSON, XML, XSLT, ODBC databases, and Web Services is advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server environments, application hosting platforms, and system administration concepts.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical and data\-related issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, business, and IT teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows curiosity and initiative by continuously learning new systems, technologies, and business processes.
* Communicates proactively, builds positive working relationships, and effectively collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented, and maintainable solutions while maintaining a high standard of quality.
* Approaches challenges with professionalism, persistence, and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment is desirable.


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: EDI Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The EDI Support Analyst will be responsible for supporting NOV’s electronic data interchange (EDI) and business\-to\-business (B2B) integrations within the Shared Services organization. This position focuses on production support, customer onboarding, and project coordination to ensure stable and efficient data exchange between NOV and its trading partners. The role requires a balance of technical acumen, communication skills, and process discipline to drive seamless integration, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across NOV’s EDI/B2B landscape.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide day\-to\-day production support for EDI/B2B transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and issue resolution.
* Monitor and troubleshoot EDI transaction failures and coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve them promptly.
* Support onboarding of new customers and suppliers to NOV’s EDI/B2B platforms.
* Partner with business users and ERP technical teams to analyze integration requirements and implement new EDI/B2B connections.
* Coordinate testing, documentation, and deployment of EDI/B2B enhancements or projects.
* Maintain transaction performance reports and support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability and data quality.
* Document and maintain partner profiles and process flows.
* Collaborate with Shared Services, Operations, and external trading partners to ensure alignment in business processes and system capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in EDI/B2B integration, including production support and project coordination.
* Working knowledge of EDI standards (e.g., ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML) and related transaction sets.
* Familiarity with integration of middleware tools (e.g., BizTalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with supply chain transactions like RFQ/Quote/PO/SO/Ship Notice/Invoice etc.
* Experience managing incident tickets and change requests (Jira, or similar).
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with customer/vendor onboarding and production support in a supply chain environment.
* Exposure to Shared Services or global IT support functions.
* Understanding of ERP integrations, preferably Oracle PO/SO/Ship/Invoice modules.

title: O9 Engineer
description:
Experience \- 5 plus years
   

  

 We are hiring an O9 Solutions Engineer to support and evolve the O9 platform for one of the largest retailers in the United States. O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day\-to\-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a primary point of support for O9 Supply Planning and Demand Planning modules, triaging incidents end\-to\-end from intake through root\-cause and resolution.
* Investigate and resolve data integrity issues between O9 and connected systems (Oracle EBS, RMA/returns feeds, buy\-plan and sourcing extracts), including mismatched quantities, missing style\-colors, and forecast data not flowing between planning modules.
* Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning\-engine anomalies.
* Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self\-service or bulk\-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume.
* Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders.
* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and regional business teams (US, UK, China, Japan) to translate business\-reported issues into technical root causes.
* Build and maintain runbooks, root\-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory.
* Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions).
* Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post\-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes.
* Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform\-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement.
* Skillset
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting or implementing O9\.
* Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style\-color management.
* Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems.
* Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end\-to\-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation.
* Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non\-technical business stakeholders across time zones.
* Comfortable working with global, cross\-regional teams (US, EMEA, APAC) and adjusting communication style accordingly.

You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.

* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience


**What We Look For**
* Postgraduate (master’s in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related field) with at least 3 years of related work experience
* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST
* Professional certifications (FRM, SCR, RAI, CFA, PRM are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
